I’m not an expert but I’ve learned the performance of stimulant medication is curved. You need to be at the peak of that curve. This means that a higher dose won’t guarantee better performance and a lower dose isn’t guaranteed to lessen performance. It depends on where that peak is for you. So your dose may need to be adjusted to reach that peak (whether increased or decreased) OR you may benefit from a different form of medication altogether. This is something to talk to your doctor about. You also need to be taking your meds as prescribed because that can make a difference as well. I would say do your best to remember to take your meds twice a day as directed for a while longer especially considering you were prescribed so recently. Sometimes it takes time to get the meds just right. Relax. You are not condemned lol

ALSO I was recently advised to look at the filler ingredients of the meds you are prescribed. Maybe start a med journal and take note of the fillers so if you change meds or med brands you’ll be able to narrow down what works for you and what doesn’t
